definitions.gloss: stiff; hard; frozen up (with cold or tension)
definitions.explanation: Describes something rigid and hard—rock-frozen food, sun-baked clay, or a body stiff with cold or nerves. Also applies figuratively to inflexible people or attitudes.
The crisp ticking sound of a small clock or watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧コチコチ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{凍|こお}っている→凍る：02100_kooru⟧。
⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧コチコチ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{固|かた}まっていた→固まる：01928_katamaru⟧。
examples.english: I was frozen stiff with nervousness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧コチコチで⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れよう→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧としない。
examples.english: He's so rigid in his thinking that he refuses to accept new methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧コチコチ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}っている→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧、コチコチ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{秒針|びょうしん}→秒針：27669_byoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: In the middle of the night, only the tick-tock of the second hand could be heard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{壁掛|かべか}け{時計|どけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧コチコチ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{時|とき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刻|きざ}んでいる→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: The old wall clock is ticking off the seconds.

notes:
Sense 1 (stiff/rigid) is far more common in everyday speech and applies to both physical hardness and mental inflexibility. Sense 2 (ticking) is the original onomatopoeic meaning. Often written in katakana for emphasis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コチコチ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧: to freeze rock-hard
- コチコチ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{固|かた}まる→固まる：01928_katamaru⟧: to become stiff (with tension)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧コチコチ: inflexible (in thinking)
- コチコチ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: to tick

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カチカチ→カチカチ：05719_kachikachi⟧: harder, sharper sound; also "clicking" of teeth
- カチンコチン: emphatic form meaning "frozen solid"
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubborn — explicit description without the physical metaphor
